# Sepsu Dev — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Software Engineer specializing in high-performance backends, modern web architectures, and fluid responsive user interfaces.

## Overview
Sepsu Dev is a portfolio application showcasing developer projects, technical stack skills, focus areas, and credentials.

## Primary Resources
- [Home](https://sepsu.dev/): Overview of profile, technical skills, and project showcase.
- [Robots](https://sepsu.dev/robots.txt): Search engine crawler directive file.

## Technical Architecture & Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router & Turbopack)
- **Language**: TypeScript & React
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS & Glassmorphism design system
- **Backend Tech**: Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker
